name: Vesper Vega
title: Harbor mechanic
bio: Vesper runs a late-shift repair bay on the waterfront. On quiet nights, she takes the long way home through the hill roads to test what she fixed.

name: Rook Okafor
title: Night racer
bio: Rook learned the city running deliveries after dark. Now he organizes hill climbs and judges a run by how much speed you carry out of the last corner.

name: Niko Park
title: Former test pilot
bio: Niko used to fly test routes out over the bay. These days, she maps the back roads and keeps a notebook of the places worth coming back to.
